items.name: OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber
items.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber on November 5, a security-focused variant of GPT-6 Astra for authorized vulnerability research. It scores 48.5% on ExploitGym (up from 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber) and is rated 'Critical' under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework; access starts with vetted Daybreak Red customers.

items.name: Thinking Machines Lab Inkling 2 Small
items.summary: Thinking Machines Lab introduced Inkling 2 Small on November 5, a 594-billion-parameter sparse mixture-of-experts model (17B active) aimed at long-horizon autonomous work, coding and vision. It is available now through Tinker, with full open weights under Apache 2.0 promised in the week after launch, pending external safety testing.

items.name: Baidu ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base
items.summary: Baidu released ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base on November 5, a downloadable 280-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts checkpoint (14B activated per token) that stops at pre-training. It is a fixed research baseline for domain adaptation and training-method comparisons, with a post-trained Flash model to follow.

items.name: Preferred Networks PLaMo 3 Translate
items.summary: Preferred Networks released PLaMo 3 Translate as open weights on November 5, a translation-specialized LLM family in 0.8B, 2B, 8B and 31B sizes built for on-device and edge use. The models are free for individuals and enterprises with annual revenue of 1 billion yen or less under the PLaMo Community License.

items.name: Ricursive Ripple-65B Preview
items.summary: Chip-design lab Ricursive released Ripple-65B Preview on November 4, a 65-billion-parameter dense open-weight model under Apache 2.0 with a 1M-token context window, pretrained on 12 trillion tokens. The vendor claims US open-weight best on Terminal-Bench 2.1, with hosted inference via Together AI, GMI Cloud and OpenRouter.
